shapeSummary: Single 31 mm diameter x 10 mm wide wheel with its axis along Z, centered at X=0 and Z=0, resting on Y=0. It has a filleted (arched) black-tire body, a recessed face on the +Z side leaving a hub and three spokes, and a blind 3 mm across-flats hex bore from the recessed side.
warnings: The 31 mm diameter and 10 mm width come from the unverified listing.
The tire and rim are fused into one solid because the image gives no clear boundary dimensions.
Recess depth, recess radius, spoke width and hub diameter are estimated from the image.
The hex bore depth is a guess; the images do not show whether it goes through.
The back face is modeled as flat. The image suggests a shallow dish, which is omitted.
The tread grooves and sidewall detail are not modeled.
cadquery:
tire = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-5).circle(15.5).extrude(10).edges().fillet(2.5)
recess = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=1).circle(12).extrude(4)
body = tire.cut(recess)
hub = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=1).circle(3.5).extrude(4)
body = body.union(hub)
for a in (90, 210, 330):
    spoke = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=1).center(6, 0).rect(12, 3).extrude(4).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), a)
    body = body.union(spoke)
bore = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-2).polygon(6, 3.464).extrude(7)
body = body.cut(bore)
part = body.translate((0, 15.5, 0))
